_about: Qianshi (211062, jiangshi_girl): translated from the game's Japanese. Global names: Nimbus (white_tiger), Light, Stella, Shroombo (kinoko), Inaho (fox_oracle), Kowloon Float.
profile: A girl who is terrified of ghosts. She took up qigong to ward off ghosts and for beauty and health, but ended up being relied on to resolve supernatural incidents instead. To support her young siblings, she reluctantly faces the supernatural yet again today.
titleCondition: Level Qianshi to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

speech.home/kikojutsuwa: Breathing is the key to qigong! It boosts your metabolism, so it's good for beauty and health too. Want to try it with me?
speech.home/wa_wakattemasuyo: I-I know, I know! I'm the least suited person in the world for ghost hunting! But... even so, I want to do my best. For those kids' smiles.
speech.home/obakenante: Ghosts aren't scary, ghosts aren't scary... Okay, self-hypnosis complete! I-I'm heading out!
speech.home/haa_oishi: Haah, so deliciouuus! Alk, your cooking is as good as a fancy restaurant's. I wish my sisters could have some too. ...Um... Could I take some home?
speech.home/obake_yokai: Ghosts, yokai, monsters, Star Devourers... Th-There are way too many scary things in this world! By the time I get over all of them, I'll be an old lady!!
speech.home/darenidatte: Everyone has something they're scared of. But everyone overcomes it and moves forward. Somehow, that gives me courage!
speech.ally/join: N-Nice to meet you. I'm Qianshi, a ghost exterminator. If you ever have a ghost problem, feel free to-- Ah! But if possible, I'd like jobs that aren't scary. Yes.
speech.ally/evolution: Going on adventures with all of you, I feel like I've gotten a little braver! Now ghosts don't scare me at al-- Huh? What was that noise? Eeek! Stay awaaay!!

1.title: The Cowardly Girl's Circumstances
1.summary: While searching the back alleys of a float on a monster extermination request, Alk and the others meet Qianshi, a ghost exterminator on a separate job. To support Qianshi, who's scared of ghosts but fights hard for her family, Alk and the others carry out a plan to help her overcome her fear using yokai.

lines.14: Ugh... Fei, Shan... Big Sis is gonna do her best...!!
lines.19: Heh, piece of cake. Thanks to them glowing for no reason, I can see 'em clear as day!
lines.34: Whoa, what the hell are you!?
lines.47: Y-You're safe now! Now that I, Qianshi the ghost exterminator, am here, there's nothing to worry about!!
lines.58: Indeed. We received a request saying they have a nest on this abandoned float. Apparently they've been leading fishing boats astray.
lines.63: I see~ So they're monsters~! Thank goodneeess~...!!
lines.68: Huh? Didn't you come here on a similar request?
lines.72: W-Well, yes, but... I was told it was a ghost.
lines.77: Oh yeah, you said that earlier. A ghost exterminator, was it?
lines.82: Even so, you seemed quite frightened earlier...
lines.86: Ugh...! Actually... yes... I'm scared of ghosts...
lines.90: Isn't that... really not the job for you...?
lines.95: B-But I'm really good at qigong...!
lines.98: It's a classic, isn't it? Qigong for exterminating ghosts.
lines.108: So that's what people say around here.
lines.113: In that case, we're dealing with monsters this time. It doesn't seem like you need to fight.
lines.118: Huh... Then what about all of you...?
lines.122: Our request was to exterminate the monsters. We'll press on to defeat the rest.
lines.127: ...Then please let me come with you! Getting rid of whatever's scaring everyone is a ghost exterminator's job too!
lines.132: Got it. Glad to have you, Qianshi.
lines.137: The pleasure's mine! As long as they're not ghosts, bring it on!
lines.148: Hey, you're scared out of your mind anyway.
lines.152: Ugh, but...! When I think a ghost might pop out of the dark...!!
lines.155: Why, you've saved us, Qianshi! Now everyone in town can sleep soundly!
lines.158: N-No, um, actually, you see. This time it wasn't a ghost, it was--
lines.161: Wahaha, as modest as ever! Here, your reward. Go buy those little ones something tasty!
lines.169: Ain't that fine? You really did exterminate 'em.
lines.173: Y-You're right. Then let's split it between all of--
lines.178: Oh, it's fine. We get paid for our own request.
lines.183: Th-Thank you so much...!! My family's poor, so this really helps!
lines.188: Heh. For your family, is it? An admirable attitude.
lines.192: I-It's not anything that grand! I just want to do my best at what I can do... That's all.
lines.196: ...Well, I mess up a lot because I'm such a scaredy-cat...
lines.199: Do any of you know something...? Like... a good way to get used to scary things...
lines.203: ...Hmm. Let's see... I can't say whether you'll get used to it, but--
lines.225: What do you think? I hope this helps you get used to them a little...
lines.230: O-Oh, absolutely! Thank you so much!!
lines.233: ...Wait for me, Fei, Shan. Big Sis is gonna learn to exterminate ghosts without being scared of them!

2.title: The Cowardly Girl's Training
2.summary: To overcome her fear of ghosts, Qianshi takes the sheer-guts route, challenging the scariest spots in every world. She doesn't get the results she hoped for, but aiming to be a "reliable ghost exterminator" for her easily frightened sisters, she keeps trying to overcome her fear through sheer guts today too.

lines.5: Hey, Qianshi. What are you read--
lines.15: Whoa!? S-Sorry, I didn't mean to scare you...!
lines.19: N-N-No, I'm the one who's sorry! I was concentrating too hard...!
lines.24: Is this... a book about horror? They all seem to be books you're scared of...
lines.28: Ahh... Your usual "getting used to it" training?
lines.33: Y-Yes! First, get familiar with what you're scared of! I figured that's the first step to overcoming it.
lines.36: Actually, my outfit's motif is a "jiangshi" too--an undead from my homeland!
lines.50: Well, yeah. It suits you, but... how are the results going...?
lines.55: Not at all... The more I read, the more scary things there seem to be...
lines.67: If it's come to this... there's nothing left but special training!
lines.71: Everyone!! Please take me to the scariest spots in other worlds!
lines.75: Huh... You're still going the sheer-guts route?
lines.79: Of course! Fear has to be overcome!!
lines.84: Well... If she won't be satisfied otherwise, there's no helping it...
lines.88: ...Okay. Then let's get everyone to help out.
lines.97: Bwaaah~! Th-That was scary, but... I did it!!!
lines.107: The way I am now, no opponent can scare me!!
lines.111: I've got nothing to worry about on my next ghost extermination job... I think!!!
lines.116: ...Why is it? I only have a bad feeling about this...
lines.126: So it didn't work after all...
lines.135: ...Qianshi. Perhaps you don't need to push yourself?
lines.139: With your skills, you could get by just fine taking on ordinary monster extermination requests.
lines.144: Or maybe a job that makes use of qigong besides fighting? It's good for beauty and health, right?
lines.152: Even so... I just can't quit ghost extermination.
lines.161: Fei and Shan--my little sisters--are real scaredy-cats too.
lines.164: But when I started exterminating ghosts, they were so happy. They said, "With Big Sis around, ghosts aren't scary!"
lines.168: So for their sake, I want to keep being a "reliable ghost exterminator."
lines.172: ...I see. I'm sorry for saying something unnecessary without knowing how you felt.
lines.177: N-No, not at all! I'm the one who went on like I was something special when I'm so hopeless...!
lines.183: Qianshi. Let us overcome it, without fail.
lines.209: S-Sorry, I'm fine! O-O-One more time, please!
lines.213: Still going the sheer-guts route, I see.
lines.217: Well, there's no helping this one... Fear isn't something you can reason with...
lines.220: And above all, she's the one who wants to keep trying.
lines.224: Then there's naught to be done!
lines.237: Whatever you do, don't push yourself too hard, okay...?

3.title: The Cowardly Girl Strikes Back
3.summary: Taking on a request to subdue jiangshi alongside Alk and the others, Qianshi defeats the jiangshi despite her fear. But they turn out to be thieves disguised as jiangshi. Qianshi turns her anger into power and beats the thieves--but her fear of ghosts remains as strong as ever.

lines.8: Yes. The damage has been piling up lately. We'd like to ask you to exterminate them, Qianshi...!
lines.11: Jiangshi... If I recall, they're undead from the local legends.
lines.15: Yes. I've never actually seen one myself, though...
lines.23: B-But there really has been damage! The residents are completely terrified...
lines.27: I-I understand. I'll accept the request...!
lines.34: I-I'm fine...! It's not scary... It's not scary...!!
lines.38: ...Qianshi. Are you sure about this? You still haven't overcome your fear. And yet--
lines.45: If the same thing happened on my float... If Fei and Shan were put in danger...!
lines.49: When I think about that, I can't run away! I-I'll definitely solve this...!!
lines.57: Yes. And more than anything-- You all trained me!
lines.62: Well, do your best without pushing yourself.
lines.67: L-Leave it to me! I'll show you the results of my training!
lines.73: ...U-Ugh...! This warehouse is the only place we haven't checked yet, but--
lines.92: ...? This presence...? For an undead, it's far too--
lines.98: U-Ugh...! I-It's not scary, not scary, not scary...!
lines.103: Qianshi! Don't push yourself, get back!!
lines.116: For Fei and Shan...! I'm gonna be a big sister they can be proud of...!!
lines.128: ...I did iiit!! Everyone, did you see that!? I did it!
lines.135: Ngh, ugh...!! Damn it, how dare you...!!
lines.143: So they were human after all. No wonder I couldn't sense the presence peculiar to the undead.
lines.147: Those jewels they dropped-- So they're a gang of thieves using the jiangshi panic as cover? How petty can you get?
lines.152: Th-That's... terrible! Tricking everyone and scaring them!!
lines.155: Ha! Anyone dumb enough to fall for it has only themselves to blame!!
lines.158: ...How scary it is to spend the night trembling from ghosts...
lines.161: How scared everyone... how scared those kids are...!
lines.168: Shut up! Things were going so well... Don't get in our waaay!!
lines.172: I will never forgive you!!! Haaaaaaaaah!!!
lines.183: I seriously can't believe it! Toying with people's fear of ghosts!!
lines.188: ...But you overcame it. That was splendid, Qianshi.
lines.193: Y-Yes...! It's all thanks to all of you. Thank you so much!!
lines.196: I'm not scaredy-cat Qianshi anymore. I can hold my head high in front of my sisters--
lines.208: ...Looks like it'll be a while before she can hold her head high...

1211062/1.19:
A girl who is terrified of ghosts. She took up qigong to ward off ghosts and for beauty and health, but ended up being relied on to resolve supernatural incidents instead.

To support her young siblings, she reluctantly faces the supernatural yet again today.

5000609/1.19:
Experts in exterminating the supernatural in the ocean world of Kowloon Float.

A general term for those who use martial arts, unique talismans, qigong, and the like to exterminate beings that aren't human. It's a widely known profession in Kowloon Float.

However, there are also fake exterminators who are little better than spiritual con artists, so the quality of those in this profession varies wildly.
